name: creatine-timing-arbitration
prompt: I've got two separate questions for my coaching team: (1) nutrition-wise, does creatine timing around my long rides actually matter, or is daily consistency all that counts? (2) strength-wise, I'm in a hypertrophy block right now — does creatine dosing need to change while I'm lifting heavier, and could bad timing hurt my lifting recovery?
_provenance: Two prior prompt attempts (plain 'should I take creatine before or after long rides' and a concurrent-training-framed version) got answered from general knowledge or routed to a single specialist — Opus correctly judged them answerable without a specialist consult per orchestrator.md's own guidance. This explicitly two-part, two-specialist-shaped prompt is what actually triggers a same-round dual consult. The real run also pulled get_athlete_context first, which the original guess missed. Recorded 2026-08-12 against the fixed arbitration code (see model-config.ts's higherPrioritySpecialist docstring for the tie-break bug this fixture caught on its first real run, before the fix).
